BackstoryDef.title: Pioneer Child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was born on a Makainian pioneer fleet, [PAWN_pronoun] is well educated by scientist aboard the colonial ship, thus giving [PAWN_objective] better understanding of makainian tech.

BackstoryDef.title: Celestial Tailor Student
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] has interest in tailoring celestial fabric since young, and has been experiment with various method of celestial fabric weaving.

BackstoryDef.title: Starbeast friend
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] has been around Makainian animals since young, and have much higher affinity with any animals [PAWN_pronoun] encounter, this make [PAWN_nameDef] give out aura that cause most animals to be friendly toward [PAWN_objective].

BackstoryDef.title: Mage Student
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] attend Makainian mage school, having study in the concept of magic, [PAWN_pronoun] is better at adapting to psycasting and magical energy.

BackstoryDef.title: Elite Pioneer
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] participate in Extra-dimensional pioneering program. braving the unknown dimension as Makai's coloniztion pioneer. [PAWN_pronoun] received a high level training to prepare for harsh surviving condition, giving [PAWN_objective] a better odd at thriving.

BackstoryDef.title: Celestial Tailor
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] work as celestial fabric tailor back in [PAWN_objective] home town, [PAWN_pronoun] know [PAWN_objective] around how to weave fabric efficiently.

BackstoryDef.title: Stardust Mercenary
BackstoryDef.description: having feel bored by peaceful life back in Makai, [PAWN_nameDef] seek thrill and excitement in real deadly combat. the feeling of blade gracing [PAWN_objective] skin, the sound of bullet fly pass give [PAWN_nameDef] the excitement [PAWN_pronoun] long for. so [PAWN_nameDef] apply as a freelance mercenary and take on various dangerous jobs.

BackstoryDef.title: Hired Security
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] has worked in a local mall as security guard, this has give [PAWN_nameDef] a basic understanding of melee combat and persuasion skill.

BackstoryDef.title: Flora Specialist
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] travel many world, collecting local flora life. [PAWN_nameDef] love researching plant life, thus giving [PAWN_pronoun] a better understanding of plant life.

BackstoryDef.title: Dimensional Tourist
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] travel many different layer of dimension, witnessing all form of wonder of the universe. [PAWN_nameDef] love peeking into another plain of existence where no eye of lesser being are meant to see, [PAWN_pronoun] has a better understanding of fabric of reality as a whole.

BackstoryDef.title: Planar-bridge operator
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] work as a plane-shift bridge operator connecting to various dimensions and plane of existence, allowing Makainian to travel to many place.

BackstoryDef.title: Space-Time Shuttle Pilot
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] work as a space-time shuttle pilot, traveling from one corner of the universe to another in the daily basis, witnessing the fold of space-time passing by.

BackstoryDef.title: Astral Walker
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] spent time traveling the universe through the 7th dimensions from one corner of the universe to another in the daily basis, witnessing the fold of space-time and shape that no mortal mind could comprehend.

BackstoryDef.title: Civilization Ambassador
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] traveling from one civilization to another, spreading the influence of Makainian. at time [PAWN_pronoun] may even went as far as creating a puppet goverment to control the entire civilization

BackstoryDef.title: Mischievous Visitor
BackstoryDef.description:
[PAWN_nameDef] often create random gadget from spare part [PAWN_pronoun] gather from higher dimension. [PAWN_pronoun] enjoy visiting lower-tier dimension civilization, posing as divine messenger and granting divine artifact of untold power to lower lifeform and then watch as the chaos unfold as they fight among themselves for these "Artifact"
at time [PAWN_pronoun] can either be a savior, or the herald of the end that brought an entire civilization to ruin.

BackstoryDef.title: Planet Driver
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] has made it [PAWN_objective] hobby to modify an entire planet and turn it into interstellar and interplanar vessel, occasionally driving it into a blackhole sending it straight into the 6th dimension, despite the complain [PAWN_pronoun] get from [PAWN_objective] colleague about not feeding a stray blackhole, [PAWN_pronoun] still keep doing it insisting that it is [PAWN_objective] pet blackhole.

BackstoryDef.title: Star Herder
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] find group of star constellation fascinating to look at, so [PAWN_pronoun] often flying around dragging newborn star together forming a new constellation of [PAWN_objective] design. this may or may not result in unintended stella collision cause by [PAWN_objective] negligence and flying straight through another star cluster.
